llm.guidance: This skill is coherent with its purpose: it needs a TICKERDB_KEY and will call api.tickerdb.com. Before installing or using it, be aware that the agent will: (1) ask for your email and a 6‑digit verification code to create/retrieve an API key, (2) display the apiKey and ask whether to save it, and (3) if you consent, the platform will persist that key. Only provide an API key you intend to share with this agent (consider creating a dedicated key with limited scope and revoking it later if needed). Verify the domain (https://api.tickerdb.com) and avoid reusing high‑privilege credentials. If you do not want the key persisted, decline when asked and set TICKERDB_KEY manually in a limited-scope environment.
